\toprule
Criterion & Study & Definition \\
\midrule
K0 & 1, 2 & \raggedright Placebo validity. On placebo logs (every request applied whatever its logged mode, so no effect exists), with $m$ = 60 hypotheses and $r$ of them at $p$ $\le$ 0.05: P(Binomial($m$, 0.05) $\ge r$) $\ge$ 0.01, and $\le$ 1 declaration. \tabularnewline
K0n & 1, 2 & \raggedright Null-outcome validity. 40 variants with KPI series cyclically shifted across episodes: rate of $p$ $\le$ 0.05 is $\le$ 0.075 pooled and $\le$ 0.10 in every family; $\le$ 5 variants with a declaration. \tabularnewline
G & 1, 2 & \raggedright Premise in the ground truth: the knockout ground truth labels sleep $\rightarrow$ neighbour protected-slice violations true ($+$). \tabularnewline
K1 & 1, 2 & \raggedright Support. Study 1: $\ge$ 60 tested sleep units with $\ge$ 15 logged rejections in every 120-episode slice. Study 2: $\ge$ 500 sleep units with $\ge$ 75 logged rejections. \tabularnewline
P1 & 1 & \raggedright Chain at 120 episodes: in $\ge$ 3 of 5 slices, the premise edge declared ($+$) and $\ge$ 3 chain edges declared with the ground-truth sign. \tabularnewline
P2 & 1 & \raggedright Small-slice F1: PMRT indirect F1 $\ge$ the baseline's in $\ge$ 6 of 10 60-episode and $\ge$ 3 of 5 120-episode slices, separately for correlation, Granger and Granger + BY. \tabularnewline
P3 & 1 & \raggedright Pooled discovery on all evaluation episodes: premise declared ($+$), $\ge$ 3 chain edges with the ground-truth sign, overall precision $\ge$ 0.80 and sign accuracy $\ge$ 0.90. \tabularnewline
SA & 1 & \raggedright Sign: overall sign accuracy $\ge$ 0.90 pooled and as the mean over the 120-episode slices. \tabularnewline
\midrule
Elig & 2, 3 & \raggedright The PMRT referee (Study 2: map-driven; Study 3: edge-certified) is eligible: energy retention $\ge$ 0.90 and every guard ratio (SVR, non-protected eMBB, LL, RLF violations, each relative to accept-all) $\le$ 1.10, point estimates. \tabularnewline
D1 & 2, 3 & \raggedright Beats the best associational map: $R^*$(PMRT) minus the largest $R^*$ of the associational maps $\ge$ 0.10, and its lower 90\,\% bound (LB90) $>$ 0, the largest map re-selected in every bootstrap resample. \tabularnewline
D2 & 2, 3 & \raggedright Beats each associational map: one-sided paired bootstrap $p$ per distinct map signature (identical rejection rules pooled), Holm at 0.05; every hypothesis rejected. \tabularnewline
D3 & 3 & \raggedright Beats the static never-sleep rule: $R^*$ difference $>$ 0 and paired LB90 $>$ 0. \tabularnewline
RLF-UB & 3 & \raggedright Secondary safety check: upper 90\,\% bound of the RLF ratio $\le$ 1.20; does not change the verdict label. \tabularnewline
\midrule
Verdict & 2 & \raggedright Referee: \verdict{invalid} (K0 or K0n) $>$ \verdict{not eligible} (Elig) $>$ \verdict{pass} (D1 and D2); \verdict{partial} (one); \verdict{fail} \tabularnewline
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
